lead: Closing a conversion gap turns the conformance case that pinned the gap red, and the case's name does not say which type it used.
body: `command-run-throws-for-a-parameter-no-argument-converts-into.nvst` reached `Core\Command::run`'s `ArgConv::Unconverted` refusal through `decimal`, so landing the `decimal` arm left it asserting nothing, and its `--EXPECT--` failed at the full verify rather than at the edit. `grep -rln '<the type>' tests/conformance/` before widening any roster, and rewrite the case with a type still on the far side of the gap.
